summary.text: After the doctor certifies the death online, download the digital death certificate from My Legacy.

steps.name: Get the details
steps.text: Get these details from the certifying doctor or hospital: the death certificate number or Confirmation of Death document number, the deceased’s Identification Document number, and the deceased’s date of death.

steps.name: Download the certificate
steps.text: After the doctor certifies the death online, visit the My Legacy website and download the digital death certificate.

example_phrasings: How do I get the death certificate?
How do I know the death was registered?

sources.page_title: How do I know that the death has been registered if I do not need to register the death? How do I obtain a death certificate?
